name: LendInvest plc
summary: LendInvest plc operates as a London-headquartered financial services firm, specializing in the management of property-related assets across the United Kingdom. The company's core business involves providing diverse real estate lending products, such as short-term bridging finance, construction funding, and buy-to-let mortgages. These offerings are made available to a broad client base, including financial intermediaries, individual property landlords, and real estate developers. In addition to its lending activities, LendInvest also oversees fund management services and holds various financial securities. The company commenced its operations in 2012.
